ada: Quick sync: finalize hosted/dedicated/private page copy + launch posts + webinar registration wiring. Need hero + 1-sentence pitch + 3 benchmark bullets + CTA per mode by EOD.
tom: I'll draft two hero tones (metric-first, outcome-first) and post here.
li: put microcopy for forms and the consult checkbox in the thread pls. small UX wins.
nate: routing plan: hidden field lead_mode; lead_mode=hosted -> hosted_trial queue; dedicated/private -> enterprise_engage. If consult_checkbox=true -> tag high_touch.
marta: benchmark plan: three short micro-cases (latency service, batch embeddings, regulated on-prem). Each = one-line result + quick method note. I'll draft.
```
HOSTED
H1: Ship LLM features, skip infra.
H2: Start in minutes, scale predictably.
Bullets: Low-latency streaming; Auto-batching reduces token cost; Curated model catalog.
CTA: Try Hosted

DEDICATED
H1: Dedicated capacity, predictable throughput.
H2: Reserved GPU pools with SLA.
Bullets: Commit pricing; Autoscale policies; Isolation for production.
CTA: Request Capacity

PRIVATE
H1: Private inference in your network.
H2: VPC, KMS, and audit-grade controls.
Bullets: HSM/KMS support; Audit logs; Air-gapped option.
CTA: Talk to Sales
```
